apps.name: VolumeBoost
confirm: This is a Windows program (.exe) for a PC. It does not run on a phone or a Mac.
It needs Equalizer APO installed. It was made for Realtek laptop speakers and may do nothing on other speakers.
It replaces Equalizer APO's config.txt. The first run keeps the old one as config.txt.bak.
Windows will warn that the publisher is unknown, because it is not code-signed. To run it anyway: More info, then Run anyway.
It adds a startup entry that puts the volume back to 100% each time you log in.
Going past 100% can distort the sound and damage speakers or hearing. I will start low.

apps.name: Video Sniffer
confirm: This is a Chrome extension for a computer. It does not work on a phone.
It is not on the Chrome Web Store. To install it: unzip, open chrome://extensions, turn on Developer mode, press Load unpacked and pick the video-sniffer folder.
It can see the address of every page and request in Chrome, because that is how it finds videos.
Without the separate yt-dlp helper (not included) some sites' videos will not download.
I will only download videos I have the right to save.
